description: Resource Type definition for AWS::Polly::Lexicon. A pronunciation lexicon that stores custom pronunciations for speech synthesis.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the lexicon.

Name.description: The name of the lexicon. Must be an alphanumeric string up to 20 characters long.

Content.description: The content of the PLS lexicon in string format.

Alphabet.description: The phonetic alphabet used in the lexicon. Valid values are ipa and x-sampa.

LanguageCode.description: The language code that the lexicon applies to.

LastModified.description: The date the lexicon was last modified (ISO 8601 timestamp).

LexemesCount.description: The number of lexemes in the lexicon.

Size.description: The total size of the lexicon, in characters.
